### Confirmed bug: menu attract scene is never drawn or animated

In `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`, `frame()` returns early whenever the game is in menu mode (lines 2362–2373). That skips both `update(dt)` and `render()`.

This conflicts with existing menu-scene logic: `render()` draws `attractZombies` and `attractPlayer` in menu mode (lines 1633–1636), and `update()` has a menu branch that advances the attract scene with `updateAttract(dt)` (lines 2324–2335). Neither runs while the game is in the menu, so the canvas won’t show or animate the intended attract scene.

**Focused fix:** In `frame()`, run `update(dt)` and `render()` for menu mode before scheduling the next animation frame. The existing menu branch in `update()` already handles the attract-scene behavior. No files were modified.
</subagent>
